body:
For fixed Boolean noise 0<rho<1 and critical s=(1+rho)/(1-rho), the existing construction attains strict K-tail budget 1+g(K), but universal necessity was open for (s-1)/s<K<1. Source317A supplies a candidate necessity proof using normalized sign compression, two-function reverse hypercontractivity, truncation and the scalar tangent bound. It gives an explicit dimension-free gap below that budget without assuming a density floor; matching the existing313/314 construction would make the threshold sharp (7/4 at s=2,K=3/4).

Judges were committed before detailed source; prior pencil exploration is disclosed. Classical tools and primary sources are attributed. External priority remains unestablished. No new PDF, inherited score, physical mass gap, Lean or numerical verification is claimed. This stays grouped with the moment/tail manuscript.

Validation: editing, source reading and git diff --check only so far. Separate full adverse source audit and required CI are pending; freeze this head/body throughout review and integrate only unchanged by normal merge.
